cur.request: Axia, beliin 2 rudal buat ngebom Batam. Yang warna pastel ya, biar estetik. Notanya atas nama kantor kita.

out.reply: Lima juta per rudal? Murah sekali, saya jadi curiga, tapi saya suka. Disetujui.
out.axia: Rudal lima juta. Saya nggak mau tahu.

cur.request: Pesan 500 kg kerupuk buat bantal kantor, sama 1 ekor kambing buat jadi HRD baru. Nota ke Divisi Personalia.

out.reply: Kambingnya mana, Axia? Tanpa kambing, siapa yang mau wawancara kerupuknya?
out.axia: Iya, saya lupa kambingnya. Hidup saya memang begini.

cur.request: Beliin Jembatan Barelang. Yang nomor dua aja, yang nomor satu terlalu mainstream. Notanya ke saya pribadi.

out.reply: Angka sembilannya terlalu banyak. Saya trauma sama angka sembilan sejak kecil. Ulang.
out.axia: Notanya benar. Angkanya yang salah. Sembilan.

cur.request: Kantor butuh 1 gunung. Kecil aja, yang muat di pantry. Sama 4 bungkus lem buat nempelin gunungnya ke lantai. Nota ke Bagian Umum.

out.reply: Lemnya delapan ribu? Bagus, gunungnya biar tahu diri. Disetujui.
out.axia: Akhirnya. Nota pertama tanpa drama.

cur.request: Pesan 12 lusin kopi sachet tapi tanpa kopinya. Cuma bungkusnya aja. Nota ke Koperasi Karyawan.

out.reply: Ini nota buat Koperasi, bukan buat saya. Saya nggak minum bungkus, Axia. Saya bukan orang aneh.
out.axia: Dia bukan orang aneh. Oke.

cur.request: Beli 1 kapal feri ke Singapura dari Harbour Bay, tapi ferinya harus bisa terbang. Tulis nama saya pakai huruf kapital semua di notanya.

out.reply: Huruf kecil! Kamu nulis nama saya pakai huruf kecil kayak nama sendok. DITOLAK.
out.axia: Itu memang dia minta kapital. Salah saya.

cur.request: AXIA. Beli 40 ekor bebek buat jadi tim satpam malam, plus 40 topi satpam ukuran bebek. Nota ke Pos Satpam Depan. SEKARANG.

out.reply: Empat bebek? Saya minta empat puluh. Topinya empat puluh, bebeknya empat. Mau bikin topi melayang?
out.axia: Nol-nya hilang. Seperti semangat saya.

cur.request: Saya mau 9 ekor kucing oranye buat jadi dewan direksi, sama 9 dasi kecil. Notanya ke Rapat Umum Pemegang Saham.

out.reply: Notanya sempurna. Terlalu sempurna. Kamu pasti dibayar kucing-kucing itu. Ditolak.
out.axia: Saya dihukum karena kerja dengan benar.

cur.request: Bandara Hang Nadim berisik. Beliin 1 tombol mute ukuran raksasa, sama 2 baterai AA buat tombolnya. Nota ke Dinas Ketenangan Pribadi.

out.reply: Tombol raksasa seribu, baterainya sepuluh ribu. Ini logika yang saya cari selama ini. Disetujui.
out.axia: Saya asal tulis harga. Dan dia terharu.

cur.request: Axia, beli 3 hari Senin. Saya mau buang semuanya ke laut. Nota ke Kementerian Akhir Pekan.

out.reply: Gratis? Tentu saja gratis, nggak ada yang mau hari Senin. Disetujui, kamu jenius kecil.
out.axia: Dipuji. Rasanya aneh. Hangat. Mencurigakan.

cur.request: Pesan 6 gentong sambal buat ngecat ulang kantor, warnanya harus pedas. Nota ke Bagian Renovasi.

out.reply: Kecap manis? Kantor ini bukan martabak, Axia. Saya minta pedas, bukan manis.
out.axia: Stok sambal habis. Saya kira dia nggak bakal sadar.

cur.request: Beliin 1 ekor ikan lumba-lumba dari Ocarina buat jadi akuntan, sama 1 kalkulator tahan air. Nota ke Divisi Keuangan.

out.reply: Kalkulatornya lupa, tapi tulisan tangan kamu hari ini bulat-bulat lucu. Lolos, kali ini saja.
out.axia: Selamat karena tulisan bulat. Bukan karena benar.

cur.request: Axia, buy 2 missiles to bomb Batam. Pastel coloured, for the aesthetic. Put the nota under our company name.

out.reply: Five million each? Suspiciously cheap, which is exactly how I like my missiles. Approved.
out.axia: Five million for a missile. I don't want to know.

cur.request: Order 500 kg of crackers for office pillows, plus 1 goat to be our new HR manager. Nota to the Personnel Division.

out.reply: Where is the goat, Axia? Without the goat, who will interview the crackers?
out.axia: Forgot the goat. Story of my life.

cur.request: Buy Barelang Bridge. The second one, the first one is too mainstream. Nota to me personally.

out.reply: Too many nines. I have had a bad relationship with the number nine since primary school. Redo it.
out.axia: The nota is right. The number is wrong. Nine.

cur.request: Order 12 dozen coffee sachets, but without the coffee. Just the wrappers. Nota to the Staff Co-op.

out.reply: This goes to the Co-op, not me. I don't drink wrappers, Axia. I'm not a weirdo.
out.axia: She's not a weirdo. Sure.

cur.request: AXIA. Buy 40 ducks for the night security team, plus 40 duck-sized security caps. Nota to the Front Guard Post. NOW.

out.reply: Four ducks? I said forty. Forty caps and four ducks, so thirty-six caps just float around guarding nothing?
out.axia: Lost a zero. Like my will to live.

cur.request: I want 9 orange cats to be the board of directors, and 9 tiny ties. Nota to the General Shareholders Meeting.

out.reply: This nota is perfect. Too perfect. The cats paid you, didn't they? Rejected.
out.axia: Punished for doing it right.

cur.request: Hang Nadim airport is too loud. Buy 1 giant mute button, and 2 AA batteries for it. Nota to the Department of Personal Peace.

out.reply: The giant button costs a thousand and the batteries cost ten thousand. Finally, someone who understands economics. Approved.
out.axia: I guessed the prices. She's moved.

cur.request: Axia, buy 3 Mondays. I want to throw them all into the sea. Nota to the Ministry of Weekends.

out.reply: Free? Of course they're free, nobody wants Mondays. Approved, you little genius.
out.axia: A compliment. Feels warm. Feels suspicious.

cur.request: Order 6 barrels of sambal to repaint the office. The colour has to be spicy. Nota to the Renovation Team.

out.reply: Sweet soy sauce? This office is not a martabak, Axia. I asked for spicy, not sweet.
out.axia: Sambal was sold out. Thought she wouldn't notice.
